AssetKit compatibility patch

Upstream: https://github.com/xtool-org/AssetKit
Revision: e763558b55fcbb5a443b1d7b2c6f0972d8bd14f7
Copyright (c) 2026 the AssetKit contributors. MIT License: see LICENSE.

xcross changes BitmapKeys.swift to derive availability masks from rendition keys,
shares the row-stride calculation between TVLEntry.swift and MLECBody.swift using
BitmapRowLayout.swift, pads bitmap rows before compression, derives bitmap
opacity flags from source alpha, and adds synthetic
regression tests. The exact diff is embedded in
lib/src/flutter/build/resources/assetkit_patch.dart and can be exported using
tool/ios_resources/assetkit_check.dart in the repository. No alternative
compiler implementation is vendored.

Generated asset compiler distributions must retain their adjacent licenses/
directory, including AssetKit MIT, LZFSE BSD-3-Clause, swift-png and h Apache-2.0
licenses and NOTICE files, and the modification/provenance record. The MIT
notice accompanying the embedded patch is also retained in the compiled CLI.
